fact_text: On 15 Jun 2026 the State Bank of Pakistan's monetary policy committee kept the policy rate unchanged at 11.5%, the final MPC meeting of FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee said the 11.5% hold was largely in line with market expectations, with the US-Iran crisis spillover still feeding into inflation and an emerging US-Iran deal a likely reason for holding.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP's policy statement kept its projections largely the same as in the previous MPC statement, and said the US-Iran crisis spillover was still showing up as inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Oil prices were in triple digits, about $100 a barrel or more, when the previous MPC was announced, and had fallen to around $90 a barrel by 15 Jun 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Pakistan's inflation was 7.3% in Apr 2026, below the level that rose to around double digits in May 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Inflation rose to around double digits in May 2026, a level the interviewee said the SBP had expected when it set the policy rate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Inflation rose mainly on food prices, higher fuel prices and higher transport prices, and transport prices rose month on month over the two months to May 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP's MPC statement put transport at roughly 23% of the inflation breakdown, and the interviewee said transport was the main driver of the monthly rise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Falling oil prices were expected to ease transport costs and so lower the transport part of inflation in the months ahead.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Core inflation rose, and the SBP said headline inflation would stay in double digits for the next few months before tapering.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee expected inflation to stay in double digits until at least Dec 2026, then possibly fall to single digits on a high base effect and slower transport and oil prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP's FY26 inflation target range is 5% to 7%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Average inflation over the first eleven months of FY26 was about 6.6%, which sits inside the SBP's 5% to 7% FY26 target range.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: If June 2026 inflation is about 10% and the following six months average about 6%, the SBP's 7% inflation target could be met, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The government's FY27 budget uses an inflation target of 8.2%, which the interviewee cited when assessing the path of inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Inflation was expected to run on the high side in the next fiscal year because of a low base effect and high general prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP said it is assessing how the budget affects its current account, inflation and GDP numbers, and expected to publish updated figures in about one month, by Jul 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP's FY26 current account target was a deficit of about $4 billion, but the interviewee expected the account to close in surplus after a sharp May 2026 fall in the trade deficit and record remittances.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The trade deficit for May 2026 fell about 34% month on month.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee expected the May 2026 current account to show a surplus, given the fall in the trade deficit and the record remittance inflow.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Workers' remittances in May 2026 reached a record of about $4.3 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Eid was a major factor behind the May 2026 remittance surge, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE both sending record inflows.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee said the Eid-driven May 2026 spike may fade, and UAE remittances, which had slowed during the Iran situation, were expected to recover.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP briefing said June 2026 remittances are expected to come in close to $4 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Remittances reached about $38 billion in FY26 to date, and the interviewee expected the full year to close near $42 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The government's FY27 remittance growth target is about 10%, and the interviewee said remittances closing near $45 billion would deliver that growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: With GDP of about $512 billion, remittances of about $45 billion would equal roughly 10% of GDP, supporting consumption and growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Goods exports are about $30 billion a year, well below the remittance inflow of about $38 billion reported to date in FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: SBP reserves stood at about $17.2 billion at the time of the meeting, on 15 Jun 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP is confident of reaching about $18 billion in reserves by end-June 2026 and $18.2 billion by the end of FY26, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP has about $700 million of prepayments and some rollovers due within one to two weeks of 15 Jun 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The international benchmark for FX buffers is three times import cover, which the interviewee said Pakistan has available.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Debt obligations at the start of FY26 were about $25 billion, and the SBP kept reserves steady through flood and external shocks.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee expected the rupee to stay stable against the dollar on demand and supply and strong reserves, but said it was too early to forecast the rupee over 12 months.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The rupee has historically depreciated about 5% to 6% a year against the dollar, a range the interviewee said he uses in his models.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP raised funds in May 2026 through Panda bonds and a Eurobond, which the interviewee described as a positive factor for reserves.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Over nine months of FY26 the primary surplus was about 3.6% of GDP and the fiscal deficit about 0.7% of GDP.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee expected the FY26 fiscal deficit to close at about 3.5% of GDP.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: About seven to eight years before FY26, Pakistan's fiscal deficit was around 8% of GDP.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The SBP expects a primary surplus of about 2% of GDP in FY27, in line with IMF expectations, and a fiscal deficit of about 3.6% of GDP is seen as achievable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee said the FBR tax revenue target may be ambitious, and the budget may be met if development (PSDP) spending is kept lower.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Pakistan has historically hit fiscal targets by cutting development (PSDP) spending, and the SBP said structural reforms are needed to reach its primary surplus target on a sustainable basis.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The FY27 agriculture growth target of about 4% may be missed because of a weak kharif season and flood impact, with services and manufacturing needed to offset it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The money market rate traded near 11.5% when the policy decision was announced, rose to about 12.5% the week before, and closed near 12.3% on 15 Jun 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The money market rate hit a six-month high of about 12.56% before easing toward 12.3% by 15 Jun 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: Secondary market yields fell by about 25 to 30 basis points on Fri 12 Jun 2026, and the decline continued into the policy decision.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee said money market and PIB yields were trading at the higher end, but yields could ease somewhat if inflation undershoots expectations in the second half of 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The KSE-100 gained about 4,600 points on 15 Jun 2026 on strong volumes, after some profit-taking during the session.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The KSE-100 showed a technical breakout near the 177,000 level, and the interviewee expected the momentum to carry through the week.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: A US-Iran deal was reported on Mon 15 Jun 2026, with signing expected on Fri 19 Jun 2026, and the interviewee said it lifted market sentiment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee said a rate cut at the next MPC was possible, because falling oil prices and a lower-than-expected inflation path in the second half of 2026 could allow it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)

fact_text: The interviewee said the dollar could strengthen globally once the crisis is resolved, though the rupee was expected to hold stable in the near term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-15)
